summary: The dock: layout tree/edit/normalize/builder, active tracking, state and state_convert with JSON persistence over the frozen fixtures, dock placement, drag, panels and the registry, TabGroup and DockArea.

implementation.history: The worker hit the 2026-10-23 usage limit after its tests were green and was resumed with its context; it re-ran against ticket 36's paint fix.

tests.per_file: layout/tree 2, layout/edit 13, layout/normalize 11, layout/builder 4, active 7, state 3, state_convert 15, dock_placement 7, drag 4, panel 2, tab_group 27, dock_area 57
tests.adapted_assertion: the frozen-tags test compares numbers numerically (Go writes 1.0 as 1)
tests.real_measurements: two 300px slots in the 1920px window measure 960/960; a dropped panel splits 960/960; a 200px slot stays 200 beside 1720

orchestrator_rerun.where: git checkout-index snapshot of HEAD f4a75d3 + ticket-26 files and fixtures (24 and 30 in-progress files excluded)
orchestrator_rerun.command: CGO_ENABLED=0 go vet ./base && gofmt -l base && go build ./...

deviations: data enums (TabGroupEvent, DockEvent, InsertTarget) as sealed interfaces; Option<Pixels> as *float32; optional indices negative-is-none (InsertTargetTabs uses Ix+HasIx); trait defaults as optional interfaces
PanelView handles do not own the panel entity (the caller's scope does); area-built placeholders and cached TabGroup/ResizableState entities live in the area's scope and are released when pruned
the Panel EventEmitter<PanelEvent> bound is not expressible; PanelEvent is defined and, as upstream, nothing in the dock subscribes
PanelViewsEqual compares panel ids (building a view would add a lease)

JSON via custom marshalers: frozen tags, {"panel": value} shape, version null when absent, missing docks omitted, missing required fields/unknown tags are errors, unknown fields ignored; states compared by value
docks walked in a fixed left/bottom/right order (upstream iterates a HashMap)
debug_assert!s in normalize/builder dropped or logged
gap 2b: plain upstream div() sites call .Block() first
